active_selection_rule: greedy canonical-name order over admissible contracted deferred candidates; skip a candidate that would exceed the remaining byte budget; stop at max_promotions; deterministic, no scores, no ranking model
config_surface: [tool_advisor.causal_frontier] mode = "off" | "observe" | "active" (default off; unknown fails closed to off)
downstream_live_suite: unavailable in this environment: no operator provider credentials and no hosted model access; structural qualification only (disposition B unless live evidence is later supplied under a follow-up plan)
fallback_behavior: insufficient structured signal abstains to the full fallback universe with no promotion; frontier construction errors fail closed to the full eligible fallback universe; unknown config values fail closed to off
frozen_at_milestone: M005 intake, after positive M004 closure (635213bc)
holdout_note: fresh post-M004-freeze holdout; does not consume the retrieval v4 holdout; every gold decision cites the host fact and contract making it admissible
no_active_change_conditions: no admissible contracted tool inside the resolved deferred universe (uncontracted-only or inadmissible-only candidate sets)
promotion_domain: admissible contracted tools inside the resolved deferred universe only; required and never-reduce tools are never selected for promotion (they bypass); uncontracted tools are never promoted and stay discoverable via tool_search
required_core_preservation: required and never_reduce tools bypass causal filtering and remain visible; core-palette immediacy unchanged except for causally promoted deferred tools; tool_search discovery universe unchanged
schema_byte_definition: serialized JSON bytes of the promoted ToolDefinition parameters payload (parameters.to_string().len()), summed over the promoted set
selected_frontier: M002 offline causal-admissibility frontier (M003 never closed positively); receipt assets/tool-advisor/causal-frontier-m002-result.json, disposition A

structural_gates.premature_mutating_exposure: no increase versus the same resolved surface without causal promotion; premature tools never promoted
structural_gates.provider_schema_budget: promoted schema bytes within schema_byte_budget per preparation

trust_boundary: no learned or external unverified contracts; only the frozen native static catalog above; a Contract2Tool-style derivation path requires its own plan and attestation design
